description: This file contains functions and constants related to managing legacy plugin manifest contracts, including reading, migrating, and repairing plugin manifest JSON files within a plugin registry system.

classes.name: LegacyManifestContractMigration
classes.description: Type representing a migration of legacy plugin manifest contracts, including manifest path, plugin ID, new raw data, and change description lines.

methods.name: buildLegacyManifestContractMigration
methods.description: Builds a migration object for a plugin manifest if legacy contract keys are detected and need to be moved or removed.

methods.name: collectLegacyPluginManifestContractMigrations
methods.description: Collects all plugin manifest migrations across the plugin registry, returning an array of migration objects.

methods.name: maybeRepairLegacyPluginManifestContracts
methods.description: Checks for legacy plugin manifest capability keys and offers to rewrite them into the new contract format, applying changes if confirmed.
